# Vloam Release Portal - Complete System & Product Reference

## Overview
Vloam produces modern, lightweight, high-performance desktop productivity software built with Go and modern web frontend architectures (Wails framework).

Official Portal: https://dl.vloam.com
GitHub Repository: https://github.com/wuqiyin/releases

---

## 1. VloamClip (Clipboard Manager)

### What is VloamClip?
VloamClip is a keyboard-driven, privacy-focused cross-platform clipboard manager crafted for developers, creators, and power users on macOS and Windows.

### Core Capabilities
- **Vim Roaming Navigation**: Full keyboard navigation support (H/J/K/L, hotkeys, search-to-paste) eliminating mouse dependence.
- **Sequential Paste Queue**: Supports FIFO (First-In-First-Out) and LIFO batch pasting for seamless data transfer workflows.
- **Privacy & Local Vault**: Local-first architecture with optional AES-256 encryption. Clipboard history never leaves the local machine.
- **Multi-Format History**: Handles plain text, rich text, code snippets with auto syntax detection, images, hex colors, and file references.
- **Instant Search**: Blazing fast fuzzy search across tens of thousands of history items without lag.

### Supported Platforms
- macOS: Apple Silicon (arm64, M1/M2/M3/M4) and Intel (x86_64), macOS 10.15 or later.
- Windows: Windows 10 and Windows 11 (x64).

### Distribution Endpoints
- Web Portal: https://dl.vloam.com/#clip
- Version Manifest: https://dl.vloam.com/clip/version.json
- Pricing: Free to download and use.

---

## 2. VloamDB (Database Client)

### What is VloamDB?
VloamDB is a lightweight, responsive desktop database GUI client that provides developers with an instant-launch, distraction-free environment for inspecting and querying databases.

### Core Capabilities
- **Multi-Engine Support**: Native connectivity for MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, and Redis.
- **Smart Query Editor**: Intelligent SQL auto-completion, format beautification, multi-tab execution, and performance timing.
- **Visual Schema Browser**: Interactive tree for tables, columns, indexes, foreign keys, and views.
- **Quick Data Export**: One-click export to CSV, JSON, and standard SQL dump files.
- **Ultra-lightweight Resource Usage**: Sub-second startup time and low memory footprint compared to Electron-based clients.

### Supported Platforms
- macOS: Apple Silicon (arm64) and Intel (x86_64), macOS 10.15 or later.
- Windows: Windows 10 and Windows 11 (x64).

### Distribution Endpoints
- Web Portal: https://dl.vloam.com/#db
- Version Manifest: https://dl.vloam.com/db/version.json
- Pricing: Free to download and use.

---

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Q: Are Vloam applications open-source or free?
A: Binaries and releases are freely available via the official release hub (https://dl.vloam.com). They can be downloaded and used without subscription fees.

### Q: Does VloamClip upload my sensitive clipboard content to the cloud?
A: No. VloamClip is strictly local-first. All data is stored in a local SQLite database with optional AES-256 encryption.

### Q: How do automatic updates work?
A: Applications check https://dl.vloam.com/<app>/version.json upon launch or via manual check, with automated domestic and global CDN fallback mirrors.
